blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Philippine National Police (PNP) on Thursday said it is considering coordinating with its foreign counterparts to track down one of the co-accused in the plunder case against former House Speaker Martin Romualdez. In a press briefing in Camp Crame, PNP public information chief Col. Allen Rae Co assured that manhunt for Joselyn Serenio, a former staffer of Romualdez who is out of the country, and another co-accused is ongoing. “As to the one who was able [to leave the country], yun ay siguro papasok na yung international cooperation with other countries regarding fugitives from the law,” Co […]...
